steps.npc: Hello. Let's get to business. I got scissors. You got hair. Want to do this?
Awesome! There are so many hair styles to pick from. What would you like?

steps.text: If the player is wearing an item on their head:
You should take off your hat if you want to get a haircut!
If the player is wearing nothing on their head:

steps.npc: Sweet! There are so many facial hair styles to pick from. What would you like?

steps.text: If the player is wearing an item on their head:
You should take off your hat if you want to get a haircut!
If the player is wearing nothing on their head:

options.text: Actually, I'd like to ask you about something else.

steps.player: Actually, I'd like to ask you about something else.

options.text: Does this aggressive business model always work?

steps.player: Does this aggressive business model always work?

steps.npc: 9 times out of 10. Though I wouldn't call it aggressive... I just like cutting straight to the point.
Speaking of straight to the point. What can I help you with?
My name is Emma. I LOVE hair! There are so many cool things you can do with it.

steps.player: I suppose there are. Have you always been a hairdresser?

steps.npc: No, I used to be a sheep shearer. However, the farmer wasn't too happy when I dyed his favourite sheep pink and gave it a side-cut.
Anyway, enough chit-chat. What can I help you with?

options.text: Who is that girl over there?

steps.player: Who is that girl over there?

steps.npc: That's Suzie, my sister. She's a bit shy around strangers, but a lovely person! I just wish more people would see that.
Only to me. She wants to, it's just... difficult.
She likes being around the shop. My hope is that when more customers come in, she'll gradually get used to strangers and open up a bit more.

steps.player: It's sweet of you to help her like that.

steps.npc: Thank you. Now... What can I do for you?
Suit yourself. Come back if you'd like a trim!
Suit yourself. Come back if you change your mind!
